findings.module: 1. PHP Webshell, RCE & Obfuscation Signature Scanner
findings.message: Potential PHP Webshell / RCE primitives detected! Found 1 signature match: eval(base64_decode...)
findings.remediation_title: Obfuscated PHP Webshell / Arbitrary Code Execution Primitive
findings.threat_analysis: Chained primitives like eval(base64_decode(...)) or unvalidated system($_GET['cmd']) allow remote unauthenticated attackers to execute arbitrary shell commands with web server (www-data) privileges.

remediation_steps.action: Strip execution permissions and move the webshell outside the public web document root.

remediation_steps.phase: 2. Inspect Web Server Access Logs for Attacker IP
remediation_steps.action: Identify the external IP addresses that made HTTP requests to this webshell.
Drop incoming packets from the identified threat actor IP.

findings.module: 2. Rogue Executable Scripts in Static/Upload Directories
findings.message: HIGH RISK: Found 1 executable script(s) in static/upload directories: avatar_cache.phtml
findings.remediation_title: Rogue Executable Script Located in Static Upload/Media Directory
findings.threat_analysis: Static directories (/uploads, /images, /cache) should only serve images and documents. An executable script in an upload folder is high-confidence evidence of an unvalidated file-upload exploit.

remediation_steps.action: Place an execution lock in the upload directory to forbid script handlers.
remediation_steps.command:
cat << 'EOF' > $(dirname "/var/www/html/wp-content/uploads/2026/02/avatar_cache.phtml")/.htaccess
<FilesMatch "\.(php|phtml|phar|pl|py|jsp|asp|sh|cgi)$">
    Require all denied
</FilesMatch>
Options -ExecCGI -Indexes
EOF

remediation_steps.phase: 3. Audit Remaining Files in Upload Directory
remediation_steps.action: Scan for any additional scripts in the upload folder tree.

findings.threat_analysis: Threat actors inject auto_prepend_file into .htaccess to automatically execute a backdoor before every legitimate web page loads, or inject RewriteCond rules to divert search engine traffic.

remediation_steps.action: Remove the injected auto_prepend_file or RewriteCond rules.
Set strict read-only permissions and optionally immutable flag.

findings.message: PHP session.upload_progress.enabled is ON! (Exploitable via PHP2Shell LFI-to-RCE race condition)
findings.remediation_title: Insecure PHP Configuration: session.upload_progress.enabled or allow_url_include
findings.threat_analysis: When session.upload_progress.enabled is On, attackers can exploit local file inclusion (LFI) via PHP2Shell race conditions. allow_url_include allows direct Remote File Inclusion (RFI).

remediation_steps.action: Locate php.ini and enforce secure directives.
Disable command execution functions in php.ini.
Reload PHP-FPM or Apache to apply the new runtime settings.
remediation_steps.command: sudo systemctl restart php*-fpm 2>/dev/null || sudo systemctl restart apache2 || sudo systemctl restart httpd
